scripts.build: npm run build -w @otcflow/shared && npm run build -w @otcflow/web
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose run --rm --entrypoint npx api prisma migrate deploy
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose run --rm --entrypoint npx api prisma db seed
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w @otcflow/shared && npm run test:unit -w @otcflow/api && npm run test:unit -w @otcflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @otcflow/shared && npm run typecheck -w @otcflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @otcflow/web
scripts.ci:fast: npm run lint && npm run db:generate -w @otcflow/api && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run db:generate -w @otcflow/api && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run db:migrate:deploy -w @otcflow/api && npm run test:integration && npm run build
